fact: The UNICEF summative evaluation of PAMEC (July 2018 to September 2022) reports the birth registration rate rose to 82.8% in 2022 from 56.5% in 2019, while use of computers for registration fell from 24% in 2019 to 13.1% in 2022.
title: Evaluation Sommative du Programme d'Appui à la Modernisation de l'Etat Civil au Burkina Faso (PAMEC) (1er juillet 2018- 30 septembre 2022)
